slides.notes: TEMPLATE — “Orbital”, immersive dark-tech deck. Style family: void black, one luminous gradient — over REAL sky: the backdrop is a sunlit Earth from the ISS (NASA, public domain; ISS007-E-10807), the sun flaring at the top behind the orbit dot, dimmed under a scrim (image opacity 0.6) so the type stays lit. Three satellites track wide low-orbit arcs across the sky behind the ring. The ring and wordmark morph through the whole deck.

slides.notes: The live-view beat: a real Earth-from-the-ISS clip (Expedition 65, NASA — public domain) plays full-bleed, muted and looping, and AUTOPLAYS the moment you present. Demonstrates the VIDEO media element embedded self-contained in the file (~290 KB, trimmed + downscaled from the 4K original with ffmpeg). One scrim, one line, a HUD “live” tag. On the editor canvas the clip shows its poster frame (inert); it only plays in present.
